quotations.old_english: Hé hét lǽdan þá hálgan tó ánum sandpytte, and setton hí þǽron, and bewurpan mid eorþan and mid weorcstánum

source_text: sand-pytt, es; m. A sand-pit :-- Hé hét lǽdan þá hálgan tó ánum sandpytte, and setton hí þǽron, and bewurpan mid eorþan and mid weorcstánum, Hml. S. 35, 325.
